response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software craftsmanship practices and experience with large-scale systems, he lacks the core technical requirements for this role. His Java expertise is limited and dated (approximately 2 years in 2016-2018), with no evidence of Kotlin knowledge, Spring ecosystem experience, or enterprise framework familiarity. His only IDE development experience was a brief 6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 working on a C IDE, and his career has shifted entirely toward TypeScript/Node.js and web platforms over the past 5+ years. The specialized JVM and IDE expertise required for this position is not demonstrated.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, clean architecture, and code quality focus demonstrated across multiple roles
Proven experience building complex, large-scale systems handling millions of requests per second with micro-services architecture at Dunnhumby
Excellent communication and teaching abilities shown through workshops, open-source projects, and community mentoring activities
concerns: Minimal and dated Java experience (approximately 2 years ending in 2018) with no demonstrated Kotlin, Spring Framework, or enterprise framework knowledge
Limited and outdated IDE/language tooling experience (only 6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015, and focused on C rather than Java)
Career trajectory over the last 5+ years focused entirely on TypeScript/Node.js and web platforms, showing significant drift away from JVM technologies
